en_title: FromSoftware's Nintendo Switch 2 Exclusive The Duskbloods Officially Delayed Into 2027
subtitle: 战斗与策略仍需打磨
opus_summary: 《The Duskbloods》宣布延期至2027年，具体日期未定。开发团队根据近期网络测试的反馈作出决定，将重点打磨战斗、策略深度和玩家表达空间。

paragraphs.en: FromSoftware has announced a delay of The Duskbloods to 2027. The Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive was due out by the end of 2026.
paragraphs.cn: From Software宣布，《The Duskbloods》延期至2027年发售。这款Switch 2独占游戏原定于2026年底前推出。

paragraphs.en: In a statement published online, the Dark Souls and Elden Ring developer said that it had decided to delay the game following feedback from the recent network test, with a focus on combat, strategic depth, and player expression.
paragraphs.cn: 这家开发了《黑暗之魂》和《艾尔登法环》的工作室在网上发布声明称，团队根据近期网络测试的反馈，决定将游戏延期，重点打磨战斗、策略深度和玩家表达空间。

paragraphs.en: There’s no word on when in 2027 The Duskbloods will launch.
paragraphs.cn: 《The Duskbloods》具体将于2027年何时发售，目前尚无消息。

paragraphs.en: Fans had braced themselves for a delay after The Duskblood was among a number of no-shows at the September 2026 Nintendo Direct . Before that, in August, FromSoftware brought The Duskbloods network test to an early end after the first day of testing resulted in "game server issues" that barred players from logging in.
paragraphs.cn: 《The Duskbloods》等多款游戏缺席了2026年9月的任天堂直面会，此后粉丝便已做好游戏延期的心理准备。更早之前，From Software在8月提前结束了《The Duskbloods》的网络测试，因为首日测试出现了「游戏服务器问题」，导致玩家无法登录。

paragraphs.en: FromSoftware is responsible for some of the most influential games of the last 20 years, including 2022 masterpiece Elden Ring. So anticipation for The Duskbloods to recreate some of that FromSoftware magic on Switch 2 is sky high.
paragraphs.cn: 过去20年间，From Software打造了多款极具影响力的游戏，其中就包括2022年的杰作《艾尔登法环》。因此，玩家对《The Duskbloods》的期待极高，希望它能在Switch 2上重现From Software的几分魔力。

paragraphs.en: Until there is more to share, you can read IGN's interview with FromSoftware's Hidetaka Miyazaki . You can also check out our preview .
paragraphs.cn: 在更多消息公布前，你可以阅读IGN对From Software的宫崎英高的采访，也可以看看我们的前瞻。
